title: Space Science Information Technology Support
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.ONR.ONR NRL.NAVAL RESEARCH LABORATORY
description_text:
The Naval Research Lab (NRL) is seeking proposals for Information Technology Support in support of NRL's Space Science Division.

Contract will include management, evaluation, procurement, system integration, programming, maintenance, training, and testing associated with resources supported by the Space Science Division information systems administration. The information technology tasks performed require knowledge and experience with system integration for desktop/cluster-based computers that include office automation systems, communication equipment, operating systems, scientific software, and business management software.

Quotes shall be submitted electronically via email on or before 04:00 P.M. EST, 31 July 2026, via email to the Contract Specialist, Tamara Jenkins, at tamara.n.jenkins.civ@us.navy.mil.
